description:
## What's New in v1.0.1

### 1. Pixel 10 Crash Fix

Fixed a major issue causing **Pixel Camera to crash on Pixel 10 devices**.

* Improved camera initialization and feature compatibility.
* Resolved crashes occurring during camera startup and usage.
* Pixel 10 users should now be able to use the backported features normally.

### 2. Pixel 10 Pro Fold — Image Saving Fix

Fixed the issue where photos captured on the **Pixel 10 Pro Fold** would appear briefly in the thumbnail but fail to save correctly.

* Fixed photo saving and media-store handling.
* Captured images should now be properly written to the device gallery.
* Improved thumbnail behavior after capturing photos.

### 3. Portrait Mode Crash Fix

Fixed crashes affecting **Portrait Mode** on supported Pixel devices.

* Improved Portrait Mode initialization.
* Fixed device-specific camera pipeline issues.
* Improved stability when switching into and out of Portrait Mode.

### 4. 5x Portrait Mode Removed

The experimental **5x Portrait Mode** has been removed from Portrait Mode in v1.0.1.

This change was made to improve stability and prevent device-specific crashes associated with the 5x Portrait pipeline.

**5x zoom remains available through the regular camera/zoom experience where supported.**

---

## Credits & Acknowledgments

* **Reverse Engineering & Development:** Akshay Kadam ([[@Akshayykadam](https://github.com/Akshayykadam)](https://github.com/Akshayykadam))
* **Patching Engine:** Morphe & Smali dexlib2
* **Base Application:** Google LLC — Pixel Camera 11.0.073

Thank you to everyone who tested **v1.0.0**, reported issues, shared logs, and helped identify device-specific problems.

**Pixel Camera v1.0.1 is primarily a stability release, and your feedback directly helped make it possible.**

patches.name: 10x Viewfinder Quick Zoom
patches.description: Unlocks the discrete 10x quick zoom button on viewfinder in Photo mode.

patches.name: Camera Looks Backport
patches.description: Enables Google Pixel 11's 10 signature Camera Looks (Sauce & Tomte) on Pixel 6 through Pixel 10.

patches.name: Pixel Camera Clone (Non-Root)
patches.description: Changes package identifier to com.google.android.GoogleCameraEng to allow side-by-side installation alongside stock Camera.

patches.name: Pixel Camera Creator Suite
patches.description: Enables Teleprompter HUD (Biotite), Live Audio VU Meter (Mica), and Social Framing Guides (Slate).

patches.name: Viewfinder Quick Access Controls
patches.description: Enables customizable Left/Right viewfinder quick-access shortcut slots and interactive 10-tick slider.
